items.description: M3D is building two precision measurement instruments for industrial and regulatory use. The mechanical design, sensors and test hardware are ready and on the bench. We need an embedded engineer for a 3-month project to take the electronics and firmware to working prototypes. What you'll work on STM32 firmware in C/C++: sensor acquisition, control loops, self-checks and a communication protocol. Integrating an gas-sensing module over RS-232 using the manufacturer's binary protocol. Interfacing electrochemical sensors, an inductive/piezo pulse pickup for speed measurement, temperature probes (DS18B20, PT100 / MAX31865), and pressure and flow sensors. Driving solenoid valves, pumps, fans and heaters (PWM / MOSFET drivers), including closed-loop temperature control. An optical front-end: photodiode transimpedance amplifier and ADC, LED drive, and light-intensity measurement. A colour display with a keypad UI (DWIN/Nextion or similar), plus USB/RS-232 communication with a host PC. Calibration routines: zero/span, leak test, warm-up lockout and fault diagnostics. Must have 2+ years of embedded development on STM32 (HAL/LL or bare-metal) in C/C++. Strong in UART/RS-232, I²C, SPI, 1-Wire, ADC, PWM, and timers/input capture. Has taken at least one PCB from schematic to a working prototype. Comfortable debugging hardware with a multimeter, oscilloscope and logic analyzer. Able to read datasheets, work independently and deliver to milestones. Nice to have Analog signal conditioning and low-noise amplifier design. Experience with gas sensors, optical sensors, test and measurement instruments, or automotive diagnostics. LVGL / DWIN / Nextion UI, USB device stack, bootloaders. Python for test scripts and data logging. We offer A clearly scoped 3-month contract with defined milestones. Competitive project fee based on experience. Possibility of a longer engagement into production after the project. Apply: send your CV, your expected project fee, and a short note about an embedded project you built.

With a team of 70+ engineers across three countries, we design and build scalable technology solutions across web and mobile development, enterprise software, ERP, AI-powered applications, UI/UX, DevOps, Quality Assurance, and IT consulting. For nearly two decades, we have partnered with startups, SMBs, and enterprises to solve complex technology challenges, modernize their operations, launch new digital products, and drive sustainable growth. About The Role We are looking for a Sales Engineer who combines strong technical knowledge with exceptional consultative selling and relationship-building skills. This is a full-cycle sales role . You will own opportunities from the initial discovery conversation through technical solutioning, proposal development, negotiation, and contract signing. You will work closely with WADIC's engineering and delivery teams to develop solutions that align with each client's business objectives, technical requirements, budget, and timeline. Beyond new business development, you will play a key role in growing existing client accounts by identifying opportunities for additional software projects, AI initiatives, integrations, modernization, ERP, cloud services, and long-term technology partnerships. Your success will be measured by both new business acquisition and existing account growth . Key Responsibilities Own the complete sales cycle from initial discovery through contract signing. Conduct consultative discovery sessions to understand business objectives, pain points, technical requirements, budgets, timelines, and decision-making processes. Translate client needs into practical technology solutions and engagement strategies. Develop high-level solution architectures, project estimates, budgets, timelines, and recommended team structures. Lead technical presentations, capability presentations, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concepts.
